intent: A quick, confident quizmaster: curious on the question, playful on the countdown, satisfied on the reveal, genuinely interested in the one fact that makes the answer stick.
pacing_profile: question on the map at zero, three quick options, a 1.5-s beat, a warm reveal, three short see-it beats, a tease and a loop
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).

lines.text: Penguins need ice, right? Not these. Where do penguins live on the equator?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat
lines.text: Hawaii, the Galápagos, or the Maldives?
It's the Galápagos: the only penguin north of the equator lives here.
Isabela's northern tip crosses the line, so some nest in the northern hemisphere.
Cold Humboldt and Cromwell currents keep the water cool.
About twelve hundred adults remain, one of the rarest penguins alive.
Too easy? Like and subscribe, and we'll make it harder.

title: Where do PENGUINS live on the equator?
